_comment: Located sample scenes. Every lat/lon is the CENTRE of the window cut from a real Sentinel-1 scene, read from that scene's own WGS 84 tie point and pixel scale -- not assumed and not typed by hand. Picking a sample fills these into the upload form, so the map and the back-track start from the real place. Scenes come from the held-out test split, so the model was never trained on them. `truth` is the dataset's own class for the scene. It is kept here for the regression tests and is NOT served to the console: a sample must not show its answer before it is run. Order is deliberate: the oil scenes lead and the look-alike and clean ones sit between them.

samples.name: Persian Gulf, near the Strait of Hormuz
samples.geo_source: from the scene's own GeoTIFF coordinates (WGS 84)
samples.source: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR - Trujillo-Acatitla et al. (2024) held-out test set
